observations: Three distinct separate images; no contact sheet substituted for assets.
Observed no lettering, logos, Z markings, HUD, crosshairs, baked capture trails, gore or bodies.
Each image has one blue-yellow FPV with four visible rotors and separately subdued fictional military equipment.
Russian invading force is the fictional narrative brief; unmarked equipment is not an identification claim about a real force or incident.
Illustrations use detailed modern pixel-art treatment; no claim of hand-authored pixel-grid or sprite-animation readiness.
